item.title: django CMS: Plugin move endpoint allows cyclic reparenting (DoS)
item.description: Score 59/100 MEDIUM — CVSS 7.1 — ### Summary The `move_plugin` admin endpoint does not prevent a plugin from being reparented under itself or one of its own descendants.
